summary: Standardized workspace test discovery by moving .test.ts files from src/ to tests/ in protocol/extensions/ui packages, updating their imports, and adding per-package vitest.config.ts files plus updated tsconfig.json includes. Then promoted several Svelte UI components (Menu, ScrollPanel, SelectField, Tabs) from apps/app to packages/ui and re-exported them, with keyed each blocks where applicable.
decisions: Move co-located .test.ts files into a sibling tests/ directory rather than keep them under src/, to separate sources from test discovery.
Re-export the promoted Svelte components (Menu, ScrollPanel, SelectField, Tabs) and their types (MenuItem, SelectOption, TabItem) from packages/ui rather than duplicating them.
Use Svelte 5 keyed each blocks for Menu items (keyed by item.label) and Tabs items (keyed by item.value) when relocating the components.
errors: Initial edit on packages/ui/src/Tabs.svelte failed with 'Found 2 occurrences of edits[1]… Each oldText must be unique' because the same `{#each items as item}` text appeared twice; resolved by providing more surrounding context for both occurrences.
